issue.title: Arc - fix NPE on injecting generics, enhance test coverage for this

body: @gwenneg thanks for pointing this out, it slipped through the original tests because I forgot about lazy init and didn't actually invoke bean method. https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/2573 should fix this.

@manovotn I just tested the master branch again and my reproducer repository is fixed, but I still have an issue (NPE) with a more complex generics injection case. I will try to update the reproducer and maybe create a new issue with more details.

issue.title: New NullPointerException on generic injection with quarkus-arc
issue.body:
**Describe the bug**
Following the #2566 issue correction on master, I tested again generics injection on a real project with a snapshot version of quarkus. The #2566 issue is fixed, but I still have an issue (NPE) with a more complex generics injection case (which works with Weld).

2. Run the `./gradlew quarkusDev` or `./mvnw compile quarkus:dev` command
3. Call the endpoint using `http://localhost:8080/cars`
